resources.string: Experimental Android client for a PC host
Important limitation: not a complete Android edition

DeepSeek Harness does not currently provide an official way to install or run Harness locally on Android.

This independently developed, unofficial experimental LAN client can only attempt to connect to a Windows PC already running Harness. On plain LAN HTTP origins, Harness 0.1.1-rc.2 has UUID, Host/Origin trust, and remote-settings limitations. Settings, providers, presets, or session features may fail even when the first page opens.

This app does not bypass those official security boundaries. Test only on a trusted private network you control; never use it over the public internet, public Wi-Fi, or a guest network.
Experimental client: a Windows PC is required, and Harness cannot run locally on Android. Plain-HTTP LAN Web features may be incomplete and currently have no login protection.
Experimental connection: a page opening does not mean every feature works. Harness may currently block RPC, settings, provider, or preset features over LAN HTTP.
